name: egp-watch
description: An investigation built only from 1,805 tender notices, amendments and contract-award notices published on Bangladesh's e-Procurement portal. A static site: no bundler, no framework, no dependencies, and nothing fetched from another host.

scripts.check: npm run check:parse && npm run check:i18n
scripts.check:parse: for f in app/*.js charts/*.js components/*.js evidence/*.js i18n/*.js search/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'every module parses'
